name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-13, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.48 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
